raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Use deterministic, bounded decoder outputs in the LoRA chunked-loss unit test instead of running an unrelated FlexAttention decoder forward.

## Why

The test is intended to validate head-only LoRA/chunked-loss values and adapter gradients. With PyTorch 2.15 on AVX2 CPU, the extra FlexAttention forward can produce non-finite outputs, so both reference and chunked losses become NaN before the behavior under test is exercised.

This keeps production code unchanged and does not add a contiguous workaround for the PyTorch issue.

## Test plan

- `python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/test_loss.py::TestChunkedLossWrapper::test_lora_head_only_matches_cross_entropy -q` (1 passed, 3 subtests passed)
- `python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/test_loss.py -q` (36 passed, 15 subtests passed)
- [TestPyPI rc3 CPU validation](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/40039784846): the target test passes on Python 3.11 and 3.12; each full suite reports 1888 passed and the same four unrelated source-wheel asset/README failures.
- All pre-commit hooks except Pyrefly pass; local Pyrefly reports the same 38 pre-existing errors on this branch and its release/0.4 base.
